title: Поклонница господина Огузка  (An Admirer for Mister Oguzok)

segments.t: As the staff members grumble about sharing facilities, Kostya comes into the kitchen to tell Max that his regular older lady has arrived in the dining room again. To the amusement of the other cooks, the guest asks specifically for Max to prepare her meal.
Фу, я после него туда не пойду.
А добрый день, добрый день, дорогие друзья.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.
Фу, я после него туда не пойду.
'Ugh, I am not going in there after him.' Explaining that ugh he is not going in there after him lays the cards on the table for Kostya.
'Good afternoon to you.' With the point and guest in play, Kostya keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
'I was simply eating.' Claiming that he was simply eating sounds confident, even if Kostya has doubts.

'You should have done it the other way around.' Pointing out that Max should have done it the other way around gives Max a sobering reality check. Russian packs the whole idea of what is allowed or needed into one impersonal word at the front.
'There is a time for everything.' Max explains that there is a time for everything, keeping his voice calm and direct.

'Your retired lady friend just arrived out there.' Over the point and the guest, Kostya answers Max without a second thought. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
А добрый день, добрый день, дорогие друзья.
'Ah, good afternoon, good afternoon, dear friends.' Around the point and guest, Max sets a calm, everyday tone with Kostya.
'Who are you filming right now?' Here wondering who Max filming right now is shows Kostya looking for the real truth.
'The thing is.' Admitting that the thing is shows Max being honest for a change.
'Film me instead.' Between the point and the guest, Kostya gives Max a quick, grounded response.
'Mister Oguzok.' Over the truth and the guest, Max answers Kostya without a second thought.

'Why does she only want you to cook?' Here asking why she only want Max to cook shows Kostya looking for the real truth. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.

'You guys are simply jealous of me.' Max tells Kostya that Kostya guys are simply jealous of him without dressing it up. Notice how he sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.
Фу, я после него туда не пойду.
А добрый день, добрый день, дорогие друзья.
That wraps up this scene as while the waitresses and cooks bicker over the restroom, Kostya informs Max that the older female guest has returned and is asking specifically for him. Until next time!
